## Scope

The `src/app` folder is the Conduit (RealWorld) Angular single-page application. It contains the root shell (`AppComponent`), routing in `app.routes.ts`, bootstrap and HTTP wiring in `app.config.ts`, `core/` (auth, interceptors, layout, models), `features/` (article, profile, settings), and `shared/` (components and pipes). The SPA must match routes, DOM selectors, `localStorage` key `jwtToken`, and `window.__conduit_debug__` from `realworld/specs/e2e/SELECTORS.md`. Relative URLs are prefixed with `https://api.realworld.show/api` in `core/interceptors/api.interceptor.ts`. Parent map under `src/`: [../AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md).

## Read first

| Topic | File |
| --- | --- |
| Route map and guards | `app.routes.ts` |
| Interceptors, `initAuth`, `ConduitDebug` | `app.config.ts` |
| Shell template | `app.component.html`, `app.component.ts` |
| Auth forms and services | `core/auth/auth.component.ts`, `core/auth/services/user.service.ts`, `core/auth/services/jwt.service.ts` |
| HTTP pipeline | `core/interceptors/api.interceptor.ts`, `core/interceptors/token.interceptor.ts`, `core/interceptors/error.interceptor.ts` |
| Navbar and footer | `core/layout/header.component.html`, `core/layout/header.component.ts` |
| Article feature | `features/article/` (pages, services, models) |
| Profile lazy routes | `features/profile/profile.routes.ts` |
| Settings | `features/settings/settings.component.ts` |
| Error UI contract | `shared/components/list-errors.component.ts` |
| E2E selectors and routes | `realworld/specs/e2e/SELECTORS.md` |

Routes in `app.routes.ts`: `''` and `tag/:tag` → home; `login`, `register` → guest-only auth; `settings`, `editor`, `editor/:slug` → `requireAuth`; `profile` → lazy profile routes; `article/:slug` → article detail.

## Rules that apply

Follow [../../RULES.md](../../RULES.md): harness-only agent edits, cite evidence paths, and explicit command status. Use standalone components, `OnPush`, and lazy `loadComponent` where routes already do. Align CSS classes and form `name` attributes with `realworld/specs/e2e/SELECTORS.md`. Domain terms: [../../DOMAIN.md](../../DOMAIN.md). Repository router: [../../AGENTS.md](../../AGENTS.md).

## Local conventions

- **Shell**: `app-layout-header`, `router-outlet`, `app-layout-footer` in `app.component.html`.
- **Token**: `JwtService` reads and writes `localStorage['jwtToken']`; `tokenInterceptor` sends `Authorization: Token <jwt>`.
- **Debug**: `app.config.ts` sets `window.__conduit_debug__` (`getToken`, `getAuthState`, `getCurrentUser`) for Playwright when `BROWSER_API` is enabled.
- **Auth startup**: `initAuth` calls `GET /user` when a token exists; 4XX purges auth; 5XX enters `unavailable` with retry per `UserService`.
- **Errors**: Validation errors render via `app-list-errors` as `.error-messages`; non-bootstrap 401 is handled through `errorInterceptor` and `purgeAuth()`.
- **Null images**: Header and profile UI use `defaultImage` pipe — align with null-field E2E expectations.

System behavior and data flow: [../../ARCHITECTURE.md](../../ARCHITECTURE.md).

| Change type | Narrowest check |
| --- | --- |
| Service, interceptor, pipe, or component in `src/app` | `bun run test` (documented); scope Vitest to `src/app` per `../../skills/run-vitest-unit-tests/SKILL.md`. |
| Routes, templates, or E2E selectors | `bun run test:e2e` (documented); optional smoke: `realworld/specs/e2e/health.spec.ts` and [add-e2e-health-spec](../../realworld/skills/add-e2e-health-spec/SKILL.md). |
| Auth token or debug surface | [add-e2e-spa-invalid-token-spec](../../realworld/skills/add-e2e-spa-invalid-token-spec/SKILL.md) and auth specs under `realworld/specs/e2e/`. |
| Profile image or bio null handling | [add-e2e-null-fields-spec](../../realworld/skills/add-e2e-null-fields-spec/SKILL.md). |
| Production bundle | `bun run build` (documented in [../../TESTING.md](../../TESTING.md)). |
